# FLX-3102: emit productRef resolves to no FLUID document in the bundle

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

An emit names the FLUID data product it fulfils by id, and that document travels in the bundle so the proven bytes are the shipped bytes. No document in the bundle declares this id.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3102
```
